items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear and the formatting matches the codebase, but the branch `elif not proxy or scheme == 'https': headers.pop('Proxy-Authorization', None)` has no comment. Neither does the new block in `add_headers` explaining why HTTPS is skipped.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The same select_proxy/get_auth_from_url/_basic_auth_str logic is copied into both `HTTPAdapter.add_headers` and `rebuild_proxies`. It also mixes proxy-auth handling into adapters/sessions, which the conventions say is unnecessary, while the real bug in utils.prepend_scheme_if_needed is left alone.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No swallowed errors. Behaviour changed, though: a stale Proxy-Authorization header is now kept when the new proxy has no username, because the old unconditional `del headers['Proxy-Authorization']` is gone. `add_headers` also adds credentials to request.headers by mutating them.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: prepend_scheme_if_needed was never changed, so parse_url's `auth` is still dropped from netloc and credentials are lost. Both F2P cases fail, e.g. `http://user:pass@example.com/path?query`. The fix went into adapters/sessions instead.
